package application

import (
	"context"

	id "metaldocs/internal/modules/iam/domain"
)

// A3.3 negative fixture (Rule 1, ALIASED import): the same forbidden call as
// lowlevel_actor.go, reached through an import alias.
//
// The rule is about which FUNCTION is being called, and that does not change
// when the author renames the package it is spelled with. An analyzer keyed to
// the identifier "iamdomain" says otherwise: it hands anyone who writes
// `import id "metaldocs/internal/modules/iam/domain"` a silent exemption from
// the one rule that keeps a missing actor from becoming "". A guard a rename
// can turn off is advice, not a guard.
//
// This file exists so alias-independence is proved rather than asserted: it
// contributes a finding whose file name appears in the fixture's Want list, so
// if a future edit went back to matching local identifiers the line stops
// appearing and the fixture fails.
//
// See scripts/testdata/guard-fixtures/README.md.
func refundTenant(ctx context.Context) string {
	return id.UserIDFromContext(ctx)
}
